issues.legal_issue: The 2019 amendment to Section 30(2)(b) of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code applies to pending appellate proceedings concerning approval of a resolution plan.

Whether a dissenting secured financial creditor is entitled under Section 30(2)(b)(ii) to payment in money of at least the liquidation value of its security interest, determined in accordance with Sections 52 and 53(1) of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.
